data.narrative:
Bedrock Ocean is a Series A–stage ocean and maritime technology company founded by Anthony DiMare and Charles Chiau that has raised $63M to date. The valuation universe consists of two comparable private companies (Seasats and Havoc AI); no public peers exist in this nascent sector.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: stage-progression modeling. Using the $63M total capital raised as a proxy for current enterprise value, a 2.0x step-up multiplier—consistent with Series A–to-subsequent-round progression—yields an implied valuation of $126M. This methodology reflects the typical capital injection and de-risking expected between investment stages in early-stage venture.

The triangulated valuation range spans $107M (low) to $145M (median $126M), with the median anchored entirely to the stage-progression result. The narrow range reflects limited data availability: only one valuation method was applicable given the private, pre-exit status of comparable companies. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.0x multiplier to Bedrock Ocean's specific risk profile, the quality of financial or growth metrics underlying the prior $63M raise, and sector-level maturity in ocean technology. Additional methods—comparable transaction multiples or DCF analysis—could not be applied without disclosure of revenue, EBITDA, or growth projections.
